title: Approve Genie tool actions in Slack and Microsoft Teams (Public Preview)
body: When Genie needs approval to run a connected external tool, the Databricks Genie apps for Slack and Microsoft Teams now show an approval prompt in the reply, so you can allow or deny the action without leaving the chat. See [Approve tool actions](/aws/en/genie-one/genie-slack#approve-tool-actions) and [Approve tool actions](/aws/en/integrations/msft-teams#approve-tool-actions).
